recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If the work group wants generic generated OperationDefinition instance narratives to split parameter sections too, handle that as a separate publisher-tooling follow-up rather than a FHIR core source correction for FHIR-5560.
issue_request: FHIR-5560 requested clearer OperationDefinition rendering by separating input and output parameters instead of showing one parameters table with an in/out use column.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite svn revision 4011. Local history maps that to git commit 31ff840c55ce318c04db44175b92d0a186397d2c, which changed the old core PageProcessor operation-page renderer to emit distinct In Parameters and Out Parameters sections for operation documentation tables.
additional_context: OperationDefinition and Patient are active current-build resources, and Patient's operations list references OperationDefinition/Patient-match. The current build's patient-operation-match.html page renders separate In Parameters and Out Parameters sections. The formal generated OperationDefinition instance narrative page still has a generic Use column, but it links to the operation documentation page and the renderer source for that generic narrative is not present in this core checkout.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source change was made. Editing OperationDefinition XML examples would not change renderer behavior, and the source-backed operation documentation output already satisfies the historical applied issue.
